A reliable navigation tool for the forest, built to work with no internet or cell coverage at all. The app helps you mark an entry point (say, where you parked the car or a forest track) and find your way back to it without fail.

The app uses fast, lightweight Mapsforge-format maps that work 100% offline. You don\'t need internet in the forest — all map data is stored right on your phone. Detailed instructions, file links, and info on where to download free maps for your region are on the neighboring "Offline maps" screen.

Press this button at the forest edge before heading into the woods. The app turns on GPS, records the exact coordinates of your entry point, and starts building your route on the map. Now you can put the phone away and focus on picking mushrooms.

When you decide to head back, press "Home". The screen switches to navigation mode. A large red arrow appears on the compass dial. No matter how you turn the phone, it always points exactly toward your entry point — just walk where it points.
[ I AM HERE ] — Finishing the trip
Once you\'re back at your starting point, press this button. The app recognizes the trip is done, stops GPS to save battery, and resets the route, getting the button ready for your next adventure.

The bottom layer (the dial) shows the cardinal directions and can work in magnetic or true mode — your choice. The top layer (the red arrow) only appears in "Home" mode. It calculates the bearing between your current position and the saved starting point. The dial rotates as you turn, while the red arrow keeps pointing at your target.

Any smartphone\'s electronic compass is susceptible to electromagnetic interference (magnetic cases, power lines, underground ore deposits) and may temporarily "stick" or misread direction. Your safety is your own responsibility. By using this app in the wild, you accept all risks. Always carry a mechanical compass, a fully charged power bank, and matches when heading deep into the forest.

To keep the compass accurate, calibrate your phone\'s sensors regularly. Raise the device and smoothly trace a figure-eight in the air while rotating the phone in a horizontal plane. Do this before entering the forest and periodically while on the move.
